figures.label: Education Budget
figures.source: NPTEL content is free to watch. Only the proctored exam for the certificate costs money. NTA's SWAYAM notice of 3 November 2025 set ₹750 for the first course and ₹600 for each extra course in the general category (₹500 and ₹400 for reserved categories), and NPTEL exams are quoted at about ₹1,000 each.
